price_basis.source: UCON / ATA / Peugeot AR published service prices, May-Jun 2026
price_basis.note: Bands are order-of-magnitude. Re-quote before deciding. Argentina: re-baseline every quarter.

items.name: Engine oil + oil filter
items.spec: 5W-40 synthetic, ACEA A3/B4, PSA B71 2296. Capacity 3.2-3.3 L with filter for the TU family; confirm on the dipstick.
items.if_unknown: Change now. Oil is the cheapest insurance on a 12-year-old TU engine.
items.notes: Peugeot Argentina plan: every 10,000 km. Do not extend to 15,000 in city use.

items.name: Air filter
items.spec: Panel filter, TU engine.
items.if_unknown: Replace now. Cheap, and it protects the throttle body and MAF/MAP readings.
items.notes: Official AR plan replaces it every 10,000 km. 15,000 is acceptable only in clean conditions.

items.name: Spark plugs
items.spec: Standard copper plugs: 30,000 km. Iridium/platinum: up to 60,000. Confirm heat range for the confirmed engine.
items.if_unknown: Replace now together with the coil check. Old plugs kill the coil pack.
items.notes: Inspect plug wells for oil at the same time (valve cover gasket).

items.name: Timing belt + tensioner + water pump
items.spec: TU3JP/KFV kit: order by engine code, do not fit the TU5JP4 134-tooth belt. Always replace tensioner, idler and water pump together.
items.if_unknown: Replace now if there is no invoice. At 12 years the belt is due by age even with low km. A broken belt bends valves.
items.notes: Aftermarket AR guidance: 80,000 km / 5 years. European 150,000 km / 10 years is not valid for Argentine use.

items.name: Accessory drive belt
items.spec: Poly-V belt + tensioner inspection.
items.if_unknown: Inspect now. Replace if glazed, cracked or noisy.
items.notes: A slipping accessory belt mimics a bad battery or alternator.

items.name: Coolant replacement
items.spec: PSA-specified coolant, do not mix chemistries. Capacity approx. 6-7 L.
items.if_unknown: Replace now and pressure-test the system.
items.notes: Never top up with plain water except as an emergency.

items.name: Brake fluid
items.spec: DOT4. Bleed all four corners.
items.if_unknown: Replace now. Fluid absorbs water and boils under load.
items.notes: Do it at the same time as any brake work.

items.name: Manual gearbox oil
items.spec: PSA-specified 75W-80 GL-4. Confirm the exact grade for the gearbox code.
items.if_unknown: Change at the next service. Cheap, and it protects the synchros.
items.notes: Hard 1st/2nd when cold is a common 207 complaint; fresh oil helps before opening the box.

items.name: Automatic gearbox ATF (AL4)
items.spec: LT 71141 ATF only. Partial drain 3.0-3.5 L; total 5.9 L. Reset the oil wear counter with a diagnostic tool.
items.if_unknown: Inspect the ATF condition before changing it. If it is burnt or the box already slips, changing fluid can make it worse.
items.notes: AL4: small heat exchanger, solenoid wear, limp mode when hot. A 30-minute hot road test is mandatory before buying any AL4 car.

items.name: Fuel filter
items.spec: In-line filter.
items.if_unknown: Replace now. Argentine fuel quality makes this a cheap win.
items.notes: A clogged filter shows as loss of power at high load, not as a code.

items.name: Cabin filter
items.spec: Pollen filter.
items.if_unknown: Replace now. It fixes most A/C smell complaints.

items.name: Battery and charging check
items.spec: 12 V battery, Midtronics-style test. Replace at 4-5 years regardless of test result.
items.if_unknown: Test now. A weak battery causes phantom electrical faults on this platform.
items.notes: Replace interval is 48 months, not a km interval.

items.name: Battery replacement
items.spec: 12 V, 50-60 Ah. Match the tray size, terminal layout and hold-down.
items.if_unknown: Replace at 4-5 years even if it still starts. There is no warning on this platform.
items.notes: Age-based only. Log the day if known; the month is enough.

items.name: Front and rear suspension inspection
items.spec: Bieletas, stabilizer bushes, lower arms and bushes, ball joints, tie rod ends, top mounts, wheel bearings, dampers, rear trailing-arm bearings, steering rack (boots, play, leaks) and its tie rods.
items.if_unknown: Inspect now. This is the documented weak point of the car in Argentina.
items.notes: Inspection only. Overhaul is a separate, larger job.

items.name: Brake inspection
items.spec: Front discs and pads, rear drums and wheel cylinders, hoses, handbrake travel.
items.if_unknown: Inspect now.
items.notes: Rear wheel cylinders leak with age and soak the drum linings.

items.name: Tire rotation, pressure and age check
items.spec: Confirm size: 185/65 R14 (1.4) or 185/60 R15 (1.6). Replace at 6 years from the DOT date even with good tread.
items.if_unknown: Check DOT date and pressure now.
items.notes: Set of four: ARS 600,000-1,200,000 depending on brand.

items.name: Wheel alignment
items.spec: Front toe and camber. Required after any suspension or steering work.
items.if_unknown: Align after the suspension inspection, not before.
items.notes: Misalignment destroys new tires in a few thousand km.

items.name: Clutch inspection (manual)
items.spec: Pedal free play, bite point, slip test in 4th at low speed.
items.if_unknown: Test on the next drive. Typical life 100,000-150,000 km in city use.
items.notes: A hard pedal means the pressure plate is at end of life. Do not wait for slip.

items.name: CV boots and driveshafts
items.spec: Inspect all four boots for cracks and grease loss. A split boot destroys the joint in weeks on dust.
items.if_unknown: Inspect now. A torn boot is cheap; a joint is not.
items.notes: Inner (gearbox side) boots fail first on this car.

items.name: Suspension: front struts (pair)
items.spec: Replace in pairs with top mounts, bearings and boots. Align afterwards.
items.if_unknown: Inspect for fluid leaks and count the rebound. Replace in pairs.
items.notes: A blown strut destroys the tire and the top mount.

items.name: Suspension: rear shocks (pair)
items.spec: Replace in pairs. Check the trailing-arm bearings at the same time.
items.if_unknown: Inspect for leaks and knocking over bumps.

items.name: Suspension: front lower arms (pair)
items.spec: Complete arms with bushes and ball joints. Replace in pairs and align afterwards.
items.if_unknown: Inspect the rear bush and the ball joint. A torn bush eats the tire edge.
items.notes: Parts 148,000-300,000 plus 72,000-206,000 labour per side. The documented weak point on Argentine roads.

items.name: Suspension: stabilizer links (pair)
items.spec: Replace in pairs with new nuts. Use branded parts.
items.if_unknown: Shake each link by hand. Play or a torn boot means replace.
items.notes: First suspect for a low-speed clunk over speed bumps.

items.name: Suspension: stabilizer bar bushes
items.spec: Central bushes, measure the bar diameter before ordering.
items.if_unknown: Inspect for cracks and hardening. Cheap while the links are off.

items.name: Steering: tie rod ends (pair)
items.spec: Replace in pairs, then align. Check the rack boots at the same time.
items.if_unknown: Rock the wheel at 3-9 o'clock and watch for play. Replace if the boot is torn.
items.notes: A torn boot loses grease and the joint fails without warning.

items.name: Brakes: front discs
items.spec: Solid discs on this car. Measure thickness; do not resurface below the limit.
items.if_unknown: Measure with a micrometer. Replace with the pads.
items.notes: Pulsation under braking means thickness variation or runout.

items.name: Brakes: front pads
items.spec: Replace as an axle set. Lubricate the caliper guides.
items.if_unknown: Measure lining thickness. Below 3 mm: replace.
items.notes: City use eats pads faster than km suggests.

items.name: Brakes: rear drums, shoes and cylinders
items.spec: Inspect cylinders for seizure and leaks. Machine or replace drums within limits.
items.if_unknown: Open the drums. A seized cylinder drags one side and overheats.
items.notes: Rear cylinders seize with age even when the car brakes straight.

items.name: Tires: full set
items.spec: 185/65 R14 (1.4) or 185/60 R15 (1.6). Replace at 6 years from DOT even with tread left.
items.if_unknown: Read the DOT week/year on all four. Rubber age is a safety item.
items.notes: Cracked, crystallized rubber in Argentine sun loses grip long before the tread wears out.

items.name: Cooling system inspection
items.spec: Hoses, thermostat housing, water pump weep hole, radiator, expansion tank cap, fan and fan resistor.
items.if_unknown: Inspect now. Overheating warps the head on this engine.
items.notes: Watch for a fan that runs constantly or never runs.

items.name: A/C service
items.spec: R134a. Leak test before recharge. Replace the cabin filter.
items.if_unknown: Test cooling performance now.
items.notes: A system that needs gas every year has a leak. Find it.

items.name: VTV (technical inspection)
items.spec: Buenos Aires (PBA): annual for cars over 2 years. The month is fixed by the last plate digit and does not move if you verify early or late. Plate ending 0 -> October.
items.if_unknown: Book the October turno. Bring cedula verde, insurance and plate. Fix lamps, wipers and horn before the appointment.
items.notes: PBA basic fee 114,106 ARS from 2026-10-15 (Resolution 2026-295, up to 2,500 kg). The fee is re-set every 6 months; check vtv.gba.gob.ar/costos before paying.

items.name: Recall and campaign check
items.spec: Check by VIN at an official dealer: rear brake line campaign YYS (2011) and the Takata airbag campaign.
items.if_unknown: Check by VIN now. Recalls are free.
items.notes: Takata: Stellantis Argentina replaces the inflator free of charge on affected units. Verify whether the 207 Compact is covered.
